authority: one Plug process and one store active lease
client_transport: same explicitly bound HTTP(S) RPC origin
identity_check: agent.brief.whoami.principal must equal configured transport principal
ontology: ontology.get selects the installed per-project native-name/category document; restore must supply actual categories, never normalize names; host-ontology.json is historical synthetic preparation only
native_category_dependency: B21 same-lane literal active/wip/done/frozen schema/runtime/import successor PENDING
ontology_content_snapshot: UNPROVEN: ontology.get is head-only; before/after reads detect observed drift but do not establish atomic ontology/content consistency
import_maps: per-project lossless original-ID -> canonical Ref; never prefix resolution

sync.normal_host_operation: all callers use the single authoritative instance; no separate per-project replica

restore_and_cutover.two_project_restoration: separate authorized lane restores both into one empty target
restore_and_cutover.shadow_trial: separate host trial; no BuildBetter staging binding
